title: A Faster Quantum Optimization Algorithm
abstract: We propose a quantum optimization algorithm with an analysis of its query complexity. The authors discuss limits under noisy execution.

title: Decoding a Surface Code Under Correlated Noise
abstract: We report a surface code decoder evaluated under a simulated correlated noise model. Performance is reported for the studied settings.

title: Control of a Superconducting Qubit Device
abstract: The paper proposes a pulse-control method for superconducting qubit hardware. The authors report results from the apparatus described in the abstract.

title: Quantum Sensing with Adaptive Measurement
abstract: We present an adaptive measurement protocol for quantum sensing. The authors report improved sensitivity within their model assumptions.

title: Many-Body Open Quantum Simulation
abstract: We propose a simulation method for an open quantum many-body system. The abstract reports agreement with a numerical reference in the examined regime.
